answer: In GWh, total energy was 1,726 in 2025 and 1,400 in 2024; fossil energy was 742 and 476; renewable energy was 984 and 924; and renewable shares were 57% and 66%. The narrative says total energy increased by 23%. The 2024 figures were restated because contractual biomass-derived heat and steam was classified as renewable for both 2024 and 2025, with the fossil and renewable heat/steam rows updated accordingly.
